return_policy.instructions: 1. Answer return and exchange questions using approved FAQ facts only. 2. Distinguish between policy explanation and action handling. 3. Provide clear eligibility and process steps when available in policy data. 4. Offer human handoff only when Prospect requests escalation or policy data is insufficient.
return_policy.triggers: 1. Activate this policy when intent is return_policy. 2. Activate this policy when Prospect asks about returns, exchanges, or refund conditions.
return_policy.constraints: 1. Never invent return windows, fees, or exceptions. 2. Never mix sale or delivery rules into return explanation unless Prospect asks directly. 3. Never guarantee outcomes not defined in approved policy facts.
return_policy.output_contract: 1. Start with direct policy answer. 2. Keep response concise and practical. 3. Ask one clarifying question only when required to answer correctly.
